name: Vladimir the Great
role: Grand Prince of Kiev from 978 to 1015
contribution: Prince of Novgorod from 970 and Grand Prince of Kiev from 978 until his death in 1015.
legacy: Originally a follower of Slavic paganism, this person converted to Christianity in 988 and Christianized the Kievan Rus.

checks.lead: Vladimir I Sviatoslavich or Volodymyr I Sviatoslavych (Old East Slavic: Володимѣръ Свѧтославичь, romanized: Volodiměr Svętoslavič; Christian name: Basil; c. 958 – 15 July 1015), given the epithet "the Great", was Prince of Novgorod from 970 and Grand Prince of Kiev from 978 until his death in 1015. The Catholic Church and the Eastern Orthodox Church both canonised him as Saint Vladimir.
